comment: D2(c) dead-producer registry (mem-hygiene-automation-v0). prefix -> exact source-value-set that proves the producer behind the prefix is dead. A prefix whose observed sources are a SUPERSET of its set (a new source appeared) or that is not registered at all FAILS CLOSED (ineligible). Hostname sources (brix/starhouse) are never registered here — that is exactly how router/ stays live until its producer dies. Adding a prefix is a deliberate config edit, never auto-inference.
